purpose: Make inspected apparatus Python modules importable through normal python -m from a private sealed regular-file package root. No kernel install, PYTHONPATH/sys.path manipulation, zipapp, native patch or new process supervisor.

layout.namespace_root: root-created0700 path outside repository, source/controller public cwd, session, profile and artifact census; contains only explicitly listed reviewed regular files plus empty __init__.py for four package dirs
layout.bridge_bootstrap: fixed root-created0700 Python executable, absolute approved existing interpreter shebang. Top-level stdlib imports only, no model-derived argv. chdir to sealed namespace, os.execve interpreter -B -m experiments....bridge --config fixedpath --config-sha256 fixedhash with exact LANG/LC_ALL/PATH/TZ env. Extension command fixed absolute bootstrappath, argv empty. Config FileBinding checked again byBridge.
layout.gate_bootstrap: same static chdir+execve, module phase_gate with fixed config/path hash. Node native --autonomous-gate gets this single executable path; rejects any unexpected script arguments. No shell command/interpolation.
layout.process_driver: root normal native python -B -m from sealed namespace, never imported in orchestration REPL. Root-provided manifests verified before invoking the native command.

seal.algorithm: existing source_closure.capture_tree over destination after all copied files written and directories closed; caller binds source expected members and resulting tree; refuse symlinks/hardlinks/special entries/out-of-root paths/no-overwrite/partial evidence reset
seal.max: 128 source members,1MiB/member,8MiB aggregate,relative paths <=4096; no raw train/session/auth files allowed in namespace membership
seal.handoff: Root rederive sealed namespace and installed Prime tree before process imports. Bootstrap path itself and all module bytes part of closed source manifest, root TCB no concurrent same-UID mutator, not fexecve/pidfd or hostilehostproof.

phase_dependency_order: Create separate source namespace from reviewed exact files and seal it.
Create root-owned model source/trusted/bridge state and static bridge config, bind source/code/inputs/context rights.
Create separate native artifact/session/tmp/cwd/profile dir identities. Task profile OAuth remains preexisting user-local; never read/copy auth.
Write gate config and static gate/bridge bootstraps outside namespace (avoid closure circular hash).
Write extension fixed binding, settings at allowed profile path, prompts and manifest files; seal frontend assets.
Write final frontend deployment under artifact_root; only then capture process config to avoid directory metadata-self-change. Process config stored outside artifact_root.
Root validates all hashes, current installedPrime tree, and prior completed-phase bindings before one-shot process command.
validation: Source/copy/config pure synthetic tests first. Test bootstrap source structure and exec argv/environment with exec mock only. No provider/auth/ORX/Docker/process run until independent integration scope.
